name: AirMove™ 1/2 Zip Jacket with Bonding | 70% Cocoa
title: AirMove™ 1/2 Zip Jacket with Bonding | 70% Cocoa
description:
Product Details
 A loose, super-lightweight jacket for track, trail and training. The versatile ½ zip design means you can adapt it as the seasons – and your body temperature – change.
 Best for: running, hybrid and high-intensity moves.
 Sweat-wicking
 Quick-dry fabric
 Funnel collar with ½ zip
 Mesh-lined back vent
 Hidden zip pockets
 Elasticated cuffs
 Adjustable drawstring hem
 Reflective heat-transfer logos
 Size & Fit
 Fit: True to size. Loose fit.
 Discover the Fabric
 A technical fabric with considered details for comfort, functionality and safety. Made to move freely on the track, on the road, or on the go.
 For: Running, hybrid and high-intensity movement.
 Fit: Loose and unrestrictive.
 Feel: Breezy. So light, it’s almost fluid.
 Finish: Matte with a smooth handfeel.
 Fabrication: 86% recycled polyester, 14% elastane. Lining: 87% polyester, 13% elastane.
 Care Instructions
 Washing instructions: Turn inside out before washing with similar colours at 30°C. Do not use fabric softener. Dry away from direct sunlight. Iron on the reverse.

name: AirMove™ Jacket | Black
title: AirMove™ Jacket | Black
description:
A multi-use, lightweight performance jacket
 Built with four-way stretch for ultimate freedom of movement
 Sweat-wicking tech keeps you dry and comfortable
 Elasticated cuffs so those sleeves stay put
 Back vent aids air flow and breathability
 Branded drawcord at the hem to switch up the look
 Reflective logos on front (left-hand side) and centre of back
 Model (Kyra) is 5'11" (180 cm) and wears a size M
 Our AirMove™ Jacket is the ultimate performance piece, whether you’re working up a sweat in or outside of the gym. Built with sweat-wicking tech and a ventilation panel at the back to keep you cool, it has plenty of stretch to help you move the way you want to. Adjust the fit with the branded drawcord at the waist – cinched or slouchy.
 Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

description:
Performance shorts with internal knickers
 Ultra-lightweight fabric with loads of stretch
 An internal drawcord at the waist gives a clean, minimal look
 Elasticated mid-rise waistband
 Available in two lengths for different coverage options
 Logo on front (left-hand side)
 Model (Kyra) is 5'11" (180 cm) and wears a size M
 The AirMove™ Lined Shorts 2” can handle working up a sweat – whatever way you’re working out.  Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

title: AirMove™ Pleated Skort with Pockets | Black
description:
Product Details
 Style meets athleticism in our flowy, high-waisted skort built with performance features. A pleated overlay gives a swishy movement, with built-in pocket shorts for your racquet balls, keys or ear pods.
 Best for: racquet sports, hybrid movement and active weekends.
 Sweat-wicking
 4-way stretch
 Quick-dry finish
 UnifiedMove™ Pocket Shorts under skirt layer
 Pockets each side of shorts
 High-rise waistband
 Updated 1.5cm reflective logos on front and back
 Size & Fit
 Fit: True to size. It’s intentionally short and cheeky across the glute area, but the built-in shorts give you added coverage.
 Inseam: S - skirt length, front: 11.8” (30cm), skirt length, back: 12.9” (33cm).The skirt lengths will scale up by 1-1.5cm for each size.
 Discover the Fabric
 A technical fabric with considered details for comfort and functionality. Made to move freely and feel weightless – on the court or out and about.
 For: Racquet sports, hybrid and high-intensity movement.
 Fit: Loose and unrestrictive.
 Feel: Breezy. So light, it’s almost fluid.
 Finish: Matte with a smooth handfeel.
 Fabrication: 86% recycled polyester, 14% elastane. Lining: 87% polyester, 13% elastane.
 Care Instructions
 Washing instructions: Turn inside out before washing with similar colours at 30°C. Do not use fabric softener. Dry away from direct sunlight. Iron on the reverse.

name: Cargo 36O Pants | 70% Cocoa
title: Cargo 36O Pants | 70% Cocoa
description:
Product Details
 Cargo pants: made for men, made iconic by women. Of course we had to make a pair. For the days you’ve got places to be – a morning hike, evening drinks, and a whole day in-between.
 Best for: everyday wear, hiking and lifting.
 Mid rise cargo pants
 Made with organic cotton
 Skinny waistband with adjustable drawstrings
 Two slip pockets at front (one with hidden zip)
 Two patch pockets at back
 Zip and popper fastening
 Toggles to pull in the bottom
 Embroidered branding on back pocket
 Size & Fit
 Fit: True to size. Oversized fit.
 Length: Short / Regular / Long
 Inseam: Short 28” (71cm) / Regular 30” (76cm) / Long 32” (82cm)
 Discover the Fabric
 A soft, organic cotton-blend fabric makes these the only cargos you’ll ever want to wear again.
 For: Hiking, lifting, climbing, everyday wear.
 Fit: Technically mid-rise, but wear low if you prefer. Roomy fit.
 Feel: Badass. Softer than you think.
 Finish: Slightly matte
 Fabrication: Main fabric: 75% organic cotton, 25% recycled nylon. Lining: 83% polyester, 17% cotton.
 Care Instructions
 Washing instructions: Fasten trims before washing with similar colours at 30°C.

name: Cargo Tote Bag | 70% Cocoa
title: Cargo Tote Bag | 70% Cocoa
description:
Product Details
 Leave extras at home? Nah. Plenty of pockets inside and out mean you’ve actually got space to take everything with you. No girl grip needed.
 Best for: a day out with the girls, office days, running errands.
 Tote bag
 Magnetic snap fastening
 Wrap-around pockets at sides
 Large zipped interior pocket
 Interior mesh water bottle pocket (fits our Stainless Steel Water Flask)
 Carabiner on side pocket for keys or jewellery
 Metal branding on the front
 Size & Fit
 Fit: One size. 
L: 43cm (17”), W: 10cm (4”), H: 30cm (12”). Volume: 13L
 Discover the Fabric
 Durable, mid-level textured nylon that’s made for life on the move. Wipe-clean lining.
 For: Travel, errands, or out and about.
 Feel: Slightly textured handfeel.
 Finish: Wipe-clean exterior.
 Fabrication: 100% nylon
 Care Instructions
 Washing instructions: Do not wash. Wipe clean only.

name: Cotton Fitted Mid Tank Top | Black
title: Cotton Fitted Mid Tank Top | Black
description:
A classic, cropped vest with a snug fit
 Peachy fabric gives it a super-soft handfeel
 Ultra-versatile design with a back-enhancing racerback style
 Fabric binding around the neck and armholes for zero chafing
 Woven, branded label on the left-hand side
 Model (Gigi) is 5'9" (175 cm) and wears a size M
 Designed for your down days, our Cotton Fitted Mid Tank Top is made from a super-soft, peachy fabric with plenty of stretch for a figure-cinching fit. It’s comfy enough to keep on all day, with a slightly cropped length that works great with both high-rise denim styles or your favourite lounge bottoms. 
 Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

name: Cotton Vintage Lounge Off-The-Shoulder Sweatshirt | Light Gray Marl
title: Cotton Vintage Lounge Off-The-Shoulder Sweatshirt | Light Gray Marl
description:
Product Details
 An off-the-shoulder sweatshirt that keeps you comfortable from workout to wind down. A marble-wash finish gives it a worn-in, vintage look.
 Best for: wearing to and from your workout, low-intensity movement and lounge days.
 Made from 100% organic cotton
 Off-shoulder neckline
 Marble-wash finish
 Raw edges with coverstitch to prevent rolling
 Embroidered wordmark logo
 Size & Fit
 Fit: True to size. Oversized and slouchy fit.
 Discover the Fabric
 Soft, slouchy and built to layer on and off between gym sessions. Made from organic cotton.
 For: Lifting, low-intensity movement and lounge days.
 Fit: Slouchy and relaxed.
 Feel: Dry hand-feel with soft inside.
 Finish: Washed, worn-in vintage look.
 Fabrication: 100% organic cotton
 Care Instructions
 Washing instructions: Turn inside out before washing with similar colours at 30°C. Do not rub isolated stains. Please note, some natural shedding of fibres may occur. Dry away from direct sunlight. Do not tumble dry.

name: Fleece Vest with Chest Pocket | Heather Gray
title: Fleece Vest with Chest Pocket | Heather Gray
description:
A slouchy, sleeveless gilet
 High collar with zip-through front
 Elasticated trims on outer edges
 Zip-fastening pocket at chest (left-hand side)
 Larger, zipped side pockets for keeping essentials safe
 Adjustable toggles to cinch the hem
 Contrasting embroidered logo on the front pocket and back of neck
 Model (Bella) is 5'6" (168 cm) and wears a size S
 Our Fleece Vest with Chest Pocket comes in a slightly longer length than our previous style, giving you more coverage through the colder months. It’s made from a cosy fleece fabric that’s trimmed with elasticated binding to help keep the cold weather out. Perfect for layering over your gymwear or weekend wardrobe.
 Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

name: FormeSoft™ Fitted Off-The-Shoulder Long Sleeve Top | 70% Cocoa
title: FormeSoft™ Fitted Off-The-Shoulder Long Sleeve Top | 70% Cocoa
description:
Product Details
 A buttery-soft long sleeve top that’s lightweight, stylish – and still built for movement. The semi-sheer finish and open neckline make it a perfect top layer.
 Best for: low-intensity training, mat work and everyday movement.
 Sweat-wicking
 4-way stretch
 Made with recycled materials
 Off-the-shoulder cut
 Thumbholes in the sleeves
 Premium, rubberised branding
 Size & Fit
 Fit: Relaxed fit. True to size.
 Discover the Fabric
 A lightweight, semi-sheer fabric that’s buttery soft and moves with the fluidity of silk.
 For: Low-intensity training and everyday movement. Not for high-intensity activities.
 Fit: Easy and relaxed.
 Feel: Buttery soft with soothing comfort.
 Finish: Semi-sheer. Perfect for layering. Avoid contact with harsh surfaces.
 Fabrication: 93% recycled polyester, 7% elastane
 Care Instructions
 Washing instructions: Turn inside out before washing and wash with similar colours at 30°C. Do not use fabric softener. Dry away from direct sunlight. Iron on the reverse.

 Lightweight and super soft fabric
 Made with sweat-wicking tech
 Contouring seams and curved hem
 Embroidered branding at the back of collar (centre)

name: Mid Crew Socks 3 Pack | Gray/White/Black
title: Mid Crew Socks 3 Pack | Gray/White/Black
description:
Product Details
 Mid Crew length is shorter than crew
 Breathable Mesh Panelling
 Jacquard Logo
 Foot Hugging Rib Knit
 Cushioned Heel/Toe
 All Round Arch Support (increase stability)
 Ergonomic Toe
 Left and Right indication
 Anti-Wicking
 Anti-Odour
 Introducing our Oner Active Mid Crew Socks, the perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and style. Meticulously engineered to meet the demands of active individuals, these socks keep your feet comfortable and fresh during any workout. 
Featuring strategically placed breathable mesh panelling, they promote optimal airflow, keeping your feet cool and dry during intense workouts. The foot-hugging rib knit offers a snug fit, preventing slipping or bunching while providing maximum support. The cushioned heel and toe design ensures comfort and shock absorption, while the ergonomic toe shape guarantees a perfect fit and reduces the risk of blisters. 
Made from high-quality organic cotton, our socks are not only incredibly soft but also eco-friendly. With anti-wicking and anti-odour properties, they keep your feet fresh and odour-free even during the most intense activities. Experience unmatched comfort and performance with our Oner Active Mid Crew Socks.
 Size & Fit
 Fit: US 4-7 & US 8-10
 Material & Care
 Fabric material: 80% Organic Cotton, 16% Polyester, 2% Elastane
 Washing instructions: 40 Degrees Machine Gentle Wash. Do not iron, bleach, tumble dry or dry clean.

name: Pilates Grip Socks 1 Pack | Black
title: Pilates Grip Socks 1 Pack | Black
description:
Breathable fabric made with organic cotton
 Distraction-free compressive fit
 Ergonomic toe design to support mobility
 Silicone grip on sole and internal heel
 Elastic strap keeps them secure throughout movement
 Anti-odour and antibacterial
 Complete your ultimate stretch look with our Pilates Grip Socks. Carefully engineered to meet the demands of Pilates and other low-impact classes, these socks keep your feet supported and fresh during movement. Silicone dots across the sole, and a silicone logo inside the heel are designed for non-slip use, and an elastic strap keeps them nice and secure, so you can focus on your workout.
 Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

description:
Product Details
 Like your favourite tee – just better in every way. We recommend keeping this premium, 100% organic cotton T-shirt away from sisters, friends, even boyfriends if you ever want to wear it again.
 Best for: everyday wear and easy layering.
 Made from 100% organic cotton
 Crew neckline
 Short sleeves
 Clean topstitching prevents rubbing at the neck
 Regular length sits just above belly button
 Embroidered branding on the back under neck
 Size & Fit
 Fit: True to size. Regular fit.
 Discover the Fabric
 Pure organic cotton, made in Portugal. This fabric feels soft, with a bit of weight and zero stretch, so it holds its shape.
 For: Everyday wear.
 Fit: Relaxed and boxy.
 Feel: A bit weightier than your average tee.
 Finish: Luxe but casual.
 Fabrication: 100% organic cotton
 Care Instructions
 Washing instructions: Turn inside out before washing with similar colours at 30°C. Do not rub isolated stains, do not tumble dry and dry away from direct sunlight.

name: Seamless Thong | Black
title: Seamless Thong | Black
description:
Everyday, comfy thong
 Made from an organic cotton seamless rib kint
 Soft-to-touch and super comfortable
 Lined gusset for hygiene
 Embroidered branding on the front (centre)
 Model (Rachel) is 5'2" (157 cm) and wears a size XS
 Comfort starts from the very first thing you put on, which is why our Seamless Thong is perfect for your rest and recovery days. Made for layering under your favourite joggers or jeans, it’s made from a cotton rib knit that feels super soft and comfortable against your skin.
 Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

name: Sherpa Jacket | 70% Cocoa
title: Sherpa Jacket | 70% Cocoa
description:
Product Details
 Our Sherpa Jacket is your winter plus-one. She’ll be coming everywhere with you on colder days. The sister to last season’s sellout fleece, but sleeker and more refined.
 Best for: easy layering on colder days.
 Borg fleece jacket
 Stand collar with soft elastic binding
 Two front zip pockets, lined with soft fabric
 Fabric hanging loop on inside of neck
 Branded zip pull
 Adjustable drawstring toggles
 Embroidered branding patch on front and back
 Size & Fit
 Fit: True to size. Oversized fit.
 Discover the Fabric
 A naturally insulating borg fleece with a soft, fluffy handfeel. Elastic binding gives it a clean finish.
 For: Easy layering and cooler weather.
 Fit: Loose, with plenty of room for layering.
 Feel: Soft and fluffy.
 Finish: Teddy-like.
 Fabrication: Main fabric: 100% polyester. Pocket lining: 100% polyester.
 Care Instructions
 Washing instructions: Turn inside out before washing separately at 30°C. Do not use fabric softener or tumble dry.

title: Soft Classic Thong | White
description:
Made from LENZING™ modal material for a soft feel
 Designed to be worn in between workouts
 A cotton gusset for breathability and hygiene
 A soft, brushback textured waistband for support and comfort
 Woven jacquard Oner label on the front
 Model (Mena) is 5’3” (160 cm) and wears a size M

 Due to the different types of dyes across collections and products, please allow for slight variations in softness, dryness and colour.

description:

 Peachy-soft bottoms with shape-shifting stretch – comfortable enough for slower days, but built with performance details to handle your workouts, too. Switch up your style with the foldover waistband.
 Best for: studio, low-intensity training, everyday movement.
 Sweat-wicking
 4-way stretch
 Mid-rise folded waistband
 Straight leg design
 Embroidered logo at back
 No PFAs
 Size & Fit
 Fit: True to size.
 Length: Short / Regular / Long
 Inseam: Short 32” (81.5cm) / Regular 34” (87.5cm) / Long 37” (93.5cm)
 Discover the Fabric
 Our stretchiest, custom-blend fabric. No digging. No distractions. Just comfort that lasts all day.
 For: Studio, low-intensity training, everyday movement. Not for high-intensity activities.
 Fit: Minimal compression, soft control.
 Feel: Like you’re wearing nothing at all.
 Finish: Brushed, peachy handfeel. Avoid contact with harsh surfaces.
 Opacity: Semi opaque. Fabrication: 81% polyamide, 19% elastane. Cut and sew construction.
 Care Instructions
 Washing instructions: Turn inside out before washing and wash with similar colours at 30°C. Do not use fabric softener or tumble dry and dry away from direct sunlight.
weightEstimateBasis: estimado: Shopify variant grams x1.10 cushion (latino-designers precedent); grams look nominal on some Oner items; source publishes no true product weight; Miami weigh-in refunds any overage as Aria credit at $13/kg

name: SoftMotion™ Mid Jacket | Cherry Lacquer Purple
title: SoftMotion™ Mid Jacket | Cherry Lacquer Purple
description:
The logos on our SoftMotion™ styles are embroidered for enhanced durability. As a result, logo placement may vary slightly.
 Fitted mid-length jacket
 Made from our softest and most stretchy fabric
 High neck collar for an elevated look
 Long sleeves with thumbholes so there's no riding up
 Flattering princess seams on the front and back
 Embroidered logo on the back of the neck (centre)
 Model (Rachel) is 5'2" (157 cm) and wears a size XS
 Made for all-day comfort, however you're moving, the SoftMotion™ Mid Jacket adds a sleek touch to your look. The super-soft and stretchy fabric feels like nothing against your skin, and has built-in sweat-wicking tech to keep you cool if you decide to work out in it.
 As Cherry Lacquer Purple is such a rich, dark shade, it requires more colouring agent to achieve the depth of colour. This results in a slightly different soft hand-feel compared to our lighter, super-soft shades. 
 This fabric is not intended for high-intensity activities or contact with harsh surfaces 
 Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

 Our iconic straight leg bottoms combine performance features with everyday ease. Supportive enough to move in, relaxed enough to live in. 
 Best for: studio, low-intensity training, everyday movement.
 The logos on our SoftMotion™ styles are embroidered for enhanced durability. As a result, logo placement may vary slightly.
 Sweat-wicking
 4-way stretch
 Glute seam
 No front seam
 Minimal support
 Updated ONER branding placement
 No PFAs
 Size & Fit
 Fit: True to size
 Lengths: Short / Regular / Long
 Inseam measurements: Short 32” (80.5cm) / Regular 34” (85.5cm) / Long 37” (94cm)
 Discover the Fabric
 Our stretchiest, custom-blend fabric. No digging. No distractions. Just comfort that lasts all day. 
 For: Studio, low-intensity training, everyday movement. Not for high-intensity activities.
 Fit: Minimal compression, soft control.
 Feel: Like you’re wearing nothing at all.
 Finish: Brushed, peachy handfeel. Avoid contact with harsh surfaces.
 Opacity: Semi opaque. Fabrication: 81% polyamide, 19% elastane. Cut and sew construction.
 Care Instructions
 Washing instructions: Turn inside out before washing and wash with similar colours at 30ºC. Do not use fabric softener or tumble dry and dry away from direct sunlight.
weightEstimateBasis: estimado: Shopify variant grams x1.10 cushion (latino-designers precedent); grams look nominal on some Oner items; source publishes no true product weight; Miami weigh-in refunds any overage as Aria credit at $13/kg

name: UnifiedMove™ High Waisted Leggings | Coal
title: UnifiedMove™ High Waisted Leggings | Coal
description:
High-waisted, with a supportive hidden mesh waistband
 Glute separation detail to enhance your natural form
 Seam glute contour detail to sculpt your physique
 Technical fabric with sweat-wicking properties and 4-way stretch
 Stitch detailing to waistband for a flattering design
 Raised heat-seal tonal logo on back
 Model (Gigi) is 5'9" (175 cm) and wears a size M
 Our UnifiedMove™ High Waisted Leggings sculpt the body with their glute-separating design and special waistband that shapes the core. The waistband is also purpose-built for performance, with an added layer of high-compression power mesh to help them stay in place while you train. Designed for next-level training with the help of our next-level lifters.
 Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

 High-waisted performance leggings with refined, streamlined bonding, side pockets and stay-cool tech for distraction-free runs and workouts.
 Best for : running, lifting and hybrid movement.
 Sweat wicking
 Compressive
 High-rise, supportive waistband
 Pockets at both sides, big enough for a phone

 Updated 1.5cm reflective logo
 Size & Fit

name: UnifiedMove™ High Waisted Pocket Leggings | Black
title: UnifiedMove™ High Waisted Pocket Leggings | Black
description:
High-rise performance leggings
 Compressive waistband has double seams to accentuate your physique
 Made from sweat-wicking, technical fabric
 Pockets on both sides are big enough to hold a phone
 Glute separation seams at the back
 Flat, reflective heat-seal logo on the back of the waistband (centre)
 Model (Gigi) is 5'9" (175 cm) and wears a size M
 We designed the UnifiedMove™ Pocket Leggings to go harder – whether that’s lifting, training or running. They’re made from our most-compressive fabric, built with moisture-wicking tech that lets you work up a serious sweat. And at the back? Subtle seamwork shows off those gains.
 Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

name: UnifiedMove™ Pocket Jacket | 70% Cocoa
title: UnifiedMove™ Pocket Jacket | 70% Cocoa
description:
A high-performance, multi-functional jacket
 Sweat-wicking fabric, with a back vent for extra ventilation
 Hidden in-seam pockets at the front to fit keys or small headphones
 Thumbholes at the cuffs keep the sleeves in place, and offer extra coverage
 Flat, reflective heat seal logos on the chest and back
 Model (Gigi) is 5'9" (175 cm) and wears a size M
 The UnifiedMove™ Pocket Jacket is made for the ones that want to go hard. It’s made from performance fabric with moisture-wicking tech and a vented back panel to stop sweat getting in your way. Thumbholes at the cuffs keep it full coverage – and stop the sleeves riding up mid-workout.
 Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

description:
Product Details
 A tech-packed performance vest with a sleek, ultra-flattering silhouette. The slim T-back strap design allows full freedom through the shoulders and traps.

 Sweat-wicking
 Compressive fabric

 Low coverage

 Washing instructions: Turn inside out before washing separately at 30°C. Don’t use fabric softener. Hang dry.
